pairs.subject: realtime-events
pairs.evidence: src/hooks/useSyncedRealtime.ts:168 The shell applies controller payloads without a reconciliation read on change or reconnect, so missed updates can leave the controller phase stale.

techniques.evidence: src/hooks/syncedRealtimeBindings.ts:44 The shell subscribes to hosted Postgres changes; it does not own the storage hook, commit staging, or capture channel.
src/hooks/useSyncedRealtime.ts:124 Every table change resets its sole 400ms refetch timer, so sustained arrivals can postpone application indefinitely instead of flushing at perceptual cadence.
src/hooks/useSyncedRealtime.ts:176 This shell owns incoming realtime subscriptions and local announcements, rather than external notification delivery with durable subscription progress.
src/hooks/useSyncedRealtime.ts:168 Controller state follows pushed rows after its initial read; this callback and reconnect handling trigger no authoritative controller reload.
